## apiome catalog {#catalog}

Catalog items: keep an item fresh from its live source and watch its drift.

```text
apiome catalog [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`drift`](#catalog-drift), [`drift-alerts`](#catalog-drift-alerts), [`refresh`](#catalog-refresh), [`refresh-policy`](#catalog-refresh-policy).

## apiome catalog drift {#catalog-drift}

What a live refresh changed in an item: classified drift and its badge.

```text
apiome catalog drift [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`dismiss`](#catalog-drift-dismiss), [`list`](#catalog-drift-list).

## apiome catalog drift dismiss {#catalog-drift-dismiss}

Clear a drift event's badge and banner (POST …/drift/{event}/dismiss; projects:edit).

The event and its changes are kept. Dismissing twice changes nothing.

```text
apiome catalog drift dismiss [OPTIONS] ITEM_ID EVENT_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ITEM_ID` | text | yes | Catalog item id. |
| `EVENT_ID` | text | yes | Drift event id (from `apiome catalog drift list`). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome catalog drift list {#catalog-drift-list}

List an item's drift events, newest first (GET …/drift).

Each event is a version a live refresh added, graded by its worst change: safe, dangerous or breaking.

```text
apiome catalog drift list [OPTIONS] ITEM_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ITEM_ID` | text | yes | Catalog item id. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--changes` | flag |  |  | Also list the newest event's classified changes. |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome catalog drift-alerts {#catalog-drift-alerts}

Who hears about catalog drift, and when: the workspace's drift alert settings.

```text
apiome catalog drift-alerts [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`set`](#catalog-drift-alerts-set), [`show`](#catalog-drift-alerts-show).

## apiome catalog drift-alerts set {#catalog-drift-alerts-set}

Change the workspace's drift alert settings (PUT …/drift-notifications; imports:edit).

Options left out keep their current value. Announcements go to the workspace's webhooks and the item's owner team; a version made by `apiome catalog refresh check` is never announced.

```text
apiome catalog drift-alerts set [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--breaking` / `--no-breaking` | flag | `--no-breaking` |  | Announce breaking drift. |
| `--dangerous` / `--no-dangerous` | flag | `--no-dangerous` |  | Announce dangerous drift. |
| `--safe` / `--no-safe` | flag | `--no-safe` |  | Announce safe drift (off: badge only). |
| `--delivery` | text |  |  | How to send: immediate, daily_digest (one webhook a day listing it all). |
| `--breaking-immediate` / `--breaking-in-digest` | flag | `--breaking-in-digest` |  | With daily_digest: send breaking drift right away, or hold it for the digest too. |
| `--email` / `--no-email` | flag | `--no-email` |  | Opt in to drift email (stored; email is not sent yet). |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome catalog refresh {#catalog-refresh}

Re-check a catalog item against its live GraphQL or gRPC endpoint on a cadence.

```text
apiome catalog refresh [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`check`](#catalog-refresh-check), [`off`](#catalog-refresh-off), [`set`](#catalog-refresh-set), [`show`](#catalog-refresh-show).

## apiome catalog refresh check {#catalog-refresh-check}

Run one live check now (POST …/refresh/check) and print the outcome.

Exit codes: 0 the check ran (unchanged or changed), 7 the check failed (the reason is printed; the item is unchanged), 1 unreachable, 2 rejected (no setting, cadence off, refresh switched off for the workspace).

```text
apiome catalog refresh check [OPTIONS] ITEM_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ITEM_ID` | text | yes | Catalog item id. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome catalog refresh off {#catalog-refresh-off}

Remove an item's refresh setting and its stored credential (DELETE …/refresh).

To pause checks but keep the setting, use ``set --cadence off`` instead. Asks first unless ``--yes`` is passed (required when not interactive).

```text
apiome catalog refresh off [OPTIONS] ITEM_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ITEM_ID` | text | yes | Catalog item id. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## apiome catalog refresh set {#catalog-refresh-set}

Create or replace an item's refresh setting (PUT …/refresh).

Changing the adapter or endpoint resets the check history. Exit codes: 0 saved, 1 unreachable, 2 rejected (unknown item, adapter that cannot be refreshed, unsafe URL, bad credential).

```text
apiome catalog refresh set [OPTIONS] ITEM_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ITEM_ID` | text | yes | Catalog item id. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--endpoint` | text |  | yes | The live endpoint: an http(s) URL for GraphQL, host:port for gRPC. |
| `--adapter` | text | `graphql` |  | How to discover it: graphql or grpc. |
| `--cadence` | text | `daily` |  | How often: off, manual, hourly, daily, weekly (off keeps the setting, checks nothing). |
| `--tls` / `--no-tls` | flag | `--no-tls` |  | gRPC only: open a TLS channel. |
| `--auth-type` | text |  |  | Credential type: none, bearer, header, oauth2. Omit to keep the stored credential; none clears it. |
| `--credentials-file` | text |  |  | JSON file with the credential fields (- for stdin), e.g. {"token": "…"}. |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome catalog refresh-policy {#catalog-refresh-policy}

The workspace switch for catalog item refresh.

```text
apiome catalog refresh-policy [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`set`](#catalog-refresh-policy-set), [`show`](#catalog-refresh-policy-show).

## apiome catalog refresh-policy set {#catalog-refresh-policy-set}

Turn catalog item refresh on or off for the workspace (PUT …/refresh-policy; imports:edit).

Off stops scheduled and manual checks for every item; each item's setting is kept.

```text
apiome catalog refresh-policy set [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--enabled` / `--disabled` | flag | `--disabled` | yes | Turn catalog item refresh on or off for the whole workspace. |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome catalog refresh-policy show {#catalog-refresh-policy-show}

Show whether catalog item refresh is on for the workspace (GET …/refresh-policy).

```text
apiome catalog refresh-policy show [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |
